nodes.text: Two cases of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) have been reported in Bengaluru, involving an eight-month-old and a three-month-old child. The children, who have no travel history, tested positive amid rising concerns about HMPV following a surge in cases in China. https://t.co/Y8qJ5rJMF0

nodes.text: The eight-month-old's case was confirmed by the Karnataka Health Department and conveyed to the Union Health Ministry. The three-month-old child was treated and subsequently discharged.
